Approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on February 24, 2025, MIUDELLA is the first hormone-free copper IUD to be introduced in the US in over 40 years. Indicated for the prevention of pregnancy for up to three years in females of reproductive potential, MIUDELLA is 99% effective.
